text:
marta: Quick note 1: proposing adapter-slab rationalization: collapse ~10 tiny adapters into 3 slabs (ingest/normalize/serve). Aim: reduce glue code and make contracts testable. RFC: https://redwood/rfcs/391
arch-bot: RFC created: https://redwood/rfcs/391 (id: 391)
lee: DB ownership during migration? enrichment writes touch multiple shards today.
marta: We'll add a write-proxy in ingress and move write ownership per-tenant. Reads can be routed to normalize while we backfill async with idempotent reconciler.
sam: Risk: p99 regressions on cutover. Mitigation?
marta: Canary by tenant cohorts + cache warmup via replay. Gate increases on p99/p95 and CPU. Auto-roll back if p99 > 20% or 5xx rate jumps > 5% for 10m.
jen: CI ask: add "slab-integ" job that runs v1+v2 adapters against a tiny fixture before any cohort.
marta: Good call. Example dry-run commands:
```
./ops/migrate_owner --cohort alpha --dry-run
./ops/migrate_owner --cohort alpha --apply --concurrency 8
```
arch-bot: Meeting: "Adapter Slab Kickoff" Fri 11:00 1 - invite sent.
marta: Thanks, will update RFC with thresholds, rollback rules, and a short runbook. @lee @jen please review.
